# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_HTF_SCORE_MODIFIER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Soften the HTF requirement for BEARISH_REJECTION setup from a hard block that rejects when HTF disagrees (htf_15m_stack != BULL) to a score penalty of -1, allowing setups with marginal HTF disagreement to still enter if overall score remains ≥ threshold. This aims to capture additional bearish setups where HTF is slightly misaligned but other confluences are strong, while preserving the core edge on J's anchor days.

## Mechanism

In the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup evaluation, replace the hard gate that returns false when htf_15m_stack != BULL with a scoring adjustment: subtract 1 from the total setup score if HTF disagrees (i.e., htf_15m_stack == BULL for a bearish setup). The passing thresholds remain: score ≥ 8/10 (if using a 10‑point scale) or ≥ 9/11 (if using an 11‑point scale) depending on the configuration. This change maintains the same threshold but allows setups with one HTF disagreement to still pass if they have enough other points.
